items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: They hired me, what you call, Emmanuel Perez, them. ... They hired me and I stayed with them.

ctx.x: Before you played with Billy Phillips Dancehall. Yeah, that was one. Yeah. And you were playing guitar in those days. Guitar, yeah. Then you changed the tenor band.

Tenor band, yeah. When did you take up the bass? I had taken up the bass after I put the tenor band on. I had taken up the bass. They hired me, what you call, Emmanuel Perez, them. They had some misunderstanding with Billy Moran, the bass player. Yes. And they led Billy Moran. It was Imperial Band. Huh? It was Imperial. Imperial Band. They hired me and I stayed with them.
Did you have any lessons on the string bass or did you pick that up?
